import subprocess,json,time
from pathlib import Path
cmd=json.loads(__import__('sys').argv[1])
start=time.monotonic_ns()
with open("formal.stdout","xb") as out, open("formal.stderr","xb") as err:
    result=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err,check=False)
with open("formal_exit.json","x") as f:
    json.dump({"command":cmd,"returncode":result.returncode,"start_ns":start,"end_ns":time.monotonic_ns()},f,indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
